text: My daily routine is simple but effective. I usually wake up at 7 a.m. and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After breakfast, I begin work at 9 a.m. and stay focused until around 5 p.m., with a short lunch break in between. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either by jogging or doing a home workout. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a show to relax. I follow this routine every day because consistency helps me stay healthy, organized, and stress-free.
